defaults.video_script: In twenty twenty Barcelona decided Luis Suarez was finished. Six years at the club, one hundred and ninety eight goals, and they called him in and told him he could leave for nothing. He broke down crying at his own farewell press conference. Lionel Messi said nothing about that club surprised him anymore. Suarez signed for Atletico Madrid, and eight months later he won the league title. Barcelona finished third.
